title: HealthTech Dashboard
shortDescription: Real-time patient monitoring dashboard for hospitals.
fullDescription:
Built a comprehensive healthcare analytics platform with real-time vitals monitoring, appointment scheduling, and HIPAA-compliant data storage. Used Next.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL with WebSocket for live updates.

## Outcomes

- Sub-2s dashboard load for clinical staff
- 500+ doctors on a single multi-tenant deploy
- 99.9% uptime over the first production quarter

testimonial.quote: Exceptional quality and attention to detail. Delivered ahead of schedule.
testimonial.author: CTO, MedCorp India

seo.metaDescription: Real-time healthcare analytics platform built with Next.js and NestJS.

title: E-Commerce Mobile App
shortDescription: Cross-platform shopping app with Razorpay integration.

## Outcomes

- Native push for order lifecycle events
